purpose: Evidence and decision record for expanding this project with systems and material setups from the Melodia project (C:/EnvironmentPortfolio/BS_GodFile). This is a spec, not a status document.

target_project.constraint: content-only: a system that lives in C++ cannot be transferred without introducing a Source tree, which this project's workflow does not carry

intake_channels.rule: Blender and other upstream Melodia code is vendored and verified through Tools/resync_fork.py against Blender/FORK_SYNC.json
intake_channels.note: This is the proven channel for bringing Melodia *systems* (procedural/Blender-side) into this project.

intake_channels.rule: Content/Materials/** is generated by Python/, never copied (Docs/CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md, Docs/GROUP_WORKFLOW.md)
not an established channel; binary .uasset carries absolute /Game/... package paths and is not relocatable

resolution_result.verdict: The drop is a byte-for-byte copy of Melodia assets whose internal package paths still point at Melodia. None of them resolve in this project.

drop_inventory.method: binary package-path scan (regex /Game/[A-Za-z0-9_/.-]+ over each .uasset) resolved against the target project's on-disk package index

dependency_closure.definition: transitive set of Melodia packages the drop requires before any of it can load
notes: The bulk is Melodia-internal texture and palette content under /Game/_PROJECT/04_Materials (Marble, Perlin, Voronoi, Swirl, Vein, Grainy, Cracks, Melt, Streak, Turbulence, Super_Perlin, nebula sources) plus MPC_Melodia_Palette.
Copying this closure would relocate roughly 89 MB of Melodia-internal art into a 14-person group film repository.

stale_references.note: Package-like strings the drop points at that do not exist in either project. Most of the /Game/_PROJECT/04_Materials/Textures/<Name> entries without a filename are folder/string literals rather than real packages; the material ones are listed explicitly.
stale_references.note_on_meshblend: Melodia holds MF_MeshBlend_Activator_Index_0 and _1, never the unsuffixed name; these are pre-existing stale references in Melodia's own assets, and Content/Materials/MF_MeshBlend_* is protected in the source project (never touch).

already_present_in_target.note: The tracked, generated spine already covers the master/toon surface this drop overlaps with. Verified present on disk:
already_present_in_target.implication: A large share of the 91 dropped masters duplicate masters this project already builds. Intake must be de-duplicated against the generated set before anything is migrated.

only_failure.cause: not genuine drift: Blender/FORK_SYNC.json currently contains merge conflict markers, so resync_fork.py raises JSONDecodeError
